cost_note: API, case and controller clocks are nested measurements and must not be added.
limits: One timing observation per cell; no repetition medians.
100 independent shared problems, not 800 or 1600 independent quality cases.
The two-mode scope was selected after inspecting the first three earlier Grid-only cases; this is an explicitly narrowed follow-up, not the original prespecified three-mode comparison.
All 800 Grid cells are fresh. The halted prior Grid study, including thirty completed Countdown/adaptive cells, is supplementary and excluded from the primary comparison.
The Grid+Ratio data are the frozen prior study; no new Both runs or control repeats were requested.
Timing sessions are separate and non-randomized. Operational watch tooling differs; observed time differences do not isolate a causal query-generator cost.
Actual rational oracle answers/winners and recorded cursor/progress evidence are checked; hypothetical geometric evaluations are not recomputed.
All terminal failures/unsolved cases stay in quality denominators. Query efficiency is compared on explicit common-correct subsets.
Native audit and same-snapshot JSON/CSV exports are retained. No duplicate full native seal is required by this study.
